source.name: Curated seed list of store-hunt rarities
source.notes: No free machine-readable live-price dataset was used at runtime. This seed was compiled from public collector lists (identities, toy numbers, series, and colors). Dollar figures are rough secondary-market estimate ranges only, not appraisals or live prices. Users can edit or extend this list in the app.

sources.title: Vanto — Hot Wheels Treasure Hunts and Super Treasure Hunts by Year
Hot Wheels Wiki (Fandom) — 2025 Treasure Hunts Series

categories.label: Super Treasure Hunt
categories.description: Hidden in mainline cases. Spectraflame-style paint and Real Riders wheels; gold flame logo on the card.

categories.label: Treasure Hunt
categories.description: Hidden in mainline cases. Circle-flame logo on the car and card.

categories.label: Car Culture / Premium Chase
categories.description: Chase cars packed in Hot Wheels Premium / Car Culture sets, not the basic mainline.

categories.label: Red Line Club
categories.description: Mattel Red Line Club exclusives. Sold to club members, not found on general retail pegs. Add specific releases you care about.

categories.label: Error / Variant
categories.description: Factory errors or scarce variants. Value varies widely; confirm before paying a premium.

categories.label: High-value / Notable
categories.description: Castings or releases known to command a premium (vintage redlines, famous prototypes, etc.).

items.valueEstimate: Varies widely; research before buying or selling
